name: Route 124
lines:
PokéNav Plus is waterproof!
I have a terrible sense of direction,
so the AreaNav app is a must-have for me!
Thanks to it, I can swim away in any direction
from Mossdeep City and come home safely.

Hey, do you know what?
Do you know what?

Let me explain then!
Try using Surf with Sharpedo.
It’ll go zooming so fast and
make you feel so great!
